name: bounded-runtime-harness
description: Plugin that packages evaluation-first governance, a bounded runtime harness, and native Codex hook guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluation-first governance and fail-closed runtime guardrails
interface.longDescription: Install this plugin to load governance skills, the bounded-runtime-harness skill, and native Codex hook guardrails. Hooks fail closed on invalid contracts, out-of-scope tool paths, and unbound result evidence. They do not replace host permissions, sandboxing, or independent verification.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold evaluation-first governance files for this repository.
Compile existing .harness contracts into a bounded runtime controller with forbidden-action tests.
